title: Single-cell transcriptomics provides insights into the stress-immune interplay and informs disease risk.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the GEO GSE334840 supplement: one 2.6 GB processed AnnData file (h5ad, a single-cell matrix format) plus a 12 KB sample sheet. Opened the sample sheet: 24 samples = 8 donors (4 female, 4 male, ages 19-28) x 3 treatments (DMSO control, cortisol, norepinephrine). Zenodo record 19787280 (CC-BY-4.0) holds two h5ad files of 2.8 GB each; I did not download them (over the 50 MB cap). The code record, Zenodo 21359854, exists.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Cell counts, cell-type annotations, the separate PBMC (peripheral blood mononuclear cell) and neutrophil runs, and the external cohorts (32 participants from the WIHS (Women's Interagency HIV Study) cohort in GSE205320; a rheumatoid arthritis cohort on CellxGene; a mouse bulk dataset GSE202662 with 4 controls and 12 stressed). The paper-cited Zenodo DOI 19787279 returns 410 Gone from the API, but doi.org redirects to record 19787280.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO FTP and Zenodo (CC-BY-4.0) are open with no login. Checked the listings and HEAD requests.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: The treatment (DMSO, CORT = cortisol, NE = norepinephrine) is a column in the sample sheet I opened. It is presumably also in the h5ad cell metadata, which I did not open.

a3_inputs_present.note: The paper describes the h5ad as processed expression with cell-type labels. Not opened.

a4_units_stated.note: Hormone doses are stated (100 nM cortisol, 10 nM norepinephrine). Expression is counts or normalised values inside the h5ad; I did not verify which.

a5_enough_rows.note: The independent unit is the donor-treatment sample: 24 samples from 8 donors, verified in the sample sheet. Cells are many but are pseudo-replicates (repeated measurements that are not independent), so honest leave-one-donor-out evaluation has only 8 folds. The disease cohorts are tiny too (32 HIV participants, a small RA cohort).

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: 2.6-2.8 GB h5ad, loadable only as one file
a6_fits_laptop.note: Each file is over the 50 MB cap and close to the 5 GB working-set limit once loaded densely. It could be subset in backed mode, but only after downloading the whole file.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: The 8 donors in the sample sheet match the paper's 'four male and four female healthy donors'. Cell counts were not checked.

a8_label_provenance.note: The label is an experimentally assigned treatment, not a model output. The disease-risk score (CytSIS) is derived from these same data, so using it as a label would be circular.

backbone.name: scGPT / Geneformer (single-cell foundation models)
backbone.hardware: CPU possible on a cell subset

integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does a cell-level stress-hormone response signature transfer to people with stress-linked disease? With 32 participants this is underpowered.

controls.positive_control: Known glucocorticoid-response genes (for example TSC22D3, FKBP5) should be up in cortisol-treated cells.
controls.negative_control: Shuffle the treatment labels within donor.
controls.external_validation: GSE205320 and the CellxGene RA cohort, both small.

honest_claim_h3: Among cells from 8 young healthy donors exposed ex vivo for 4-24 h, the model distinguishes cortisol-, norepinephrine- and vehicle-treated cells. Any disease claim rests on cohorts of tens of people.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use single-cell gene expression of blood immune cells to predict whether they were exposed to cortisol, norepinephrine or neither.
plain_idea.train_on: Expression profiles of individual blood immune cells (cell count unknown; not opened) from 24 samples across 8 donors.
plain_idea.predict: Treatment group, which the experimenters assigned in a culture dish at fixed hormone doses.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: A stress-exposure classifier could flag stress-hormone signatures in patient blood. With 8 donors, though, any generalisation claim is weak.

ml_idea: Cell-level classifier of hormone exposure, with leave-one-donor-out evaluation and transfer to disease cohorts. Rejected: 8 donors and a 2.6 GB working file.

effort.compute_note: Not timed. The file sizes come from the GEO and Zenodo listings; the cell count is unknown, so RAM and runtime were not estimated.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the donors in the sample sheet: 8, already done, which kills the project.

verdict_reason: Fails A5 because the true sample size is 24 samples from 8 donors (verified in the GEO sample sheet), and the external disease cohorts have tens of people. The only processed data is a 2.6 GB h5ad, over the download cap.
